decision: held: 17720017 (Tang 2007 Lancet) is the only declared source that pools calcium monotherapy, but its full text is subscription-only and not retrievable; the calcium-alone subgroup, included-trial dose range and dosage forms cannot be verified from the abstract, and its pooled estimate mixes calcium-alone and calcium+vitamin D trials. 26510847 is a calcium+vitamin D combination meta-analysis (not this ingredient alone) whose erratum 27401092 could not be retrieved.
summary: 26510847 (NOF 2016) pools 8 RCTs of calcium plus vitamin D (calcium 500-1200 mg/day with vitamin D 400-800 IU/day, Table 1): total fracture SRRE 0.85 and hip fracture 0.70; it is combination evidence and cannot credit calcium alone, and its erratum text was not retrievable. 17720017 (29 RCTs, n=63,897, people >=50) supports calcium or calcium+D for fracture (RR 0.88) and bone loss, but only the abstract is accessible, so the calcium-alone result, dose range and forms cannot be verified. The record's bone-health claim is not refuted, so it is not downgraded to reference; it stays held.
